teachingBodiesReviewedAndCorrected.heading: Confirm with paired IgG IFA
teachingBodiesReviewedAndCorrected.before: Collect acute and convalescent serum about 2 to 4 weeks apart. A fourfold rise supports acute infection, while one elevated titer can reflect prior exposure.
teachingBodiesReviewedAndCorrected.after: For RMSF, collect acute and convalescent IgG IFA serum samples 2 to 10 weeks apart, as specified by current CDC diagnostic guidance. Interpret a fourfold rise with a compatible illness; one elevated titer can reflect prior exposure.
teachingBodiesReviewedAndCorrected.source: CDC current RMSF diagnosis serology; dated CDC2016 Table4 recommends ideally 2-4 weeks for the broader group.

teachingBodiesReviewedAndCorrected.heading: Manage severe allergy as an emergency
teachingBodiesReviewedAndCorrected.before: Life threatening doxycycline allergy with suspected RMSF can warrant inpatient rapid desensitization. Chloramphenicol has worse RMSF outcomes and does not cover ehrlichiosis or anaplasmosis.
teachingBodiesReviewedAndCorrected.after: Clarify the reported reaction and involve an appropriate specialist. In selected immediate hypersensitivity reactions, inpatient rapid desensitization may be considered; evidence is limited to case reports. This is not an automatic pathway for every severe reaction. Chloramphenicol has worse RMSF outcomes and does not cover ehrlichiosis or anaplasmosis.
teachingBodiesReviewedAndCorrected.source: CDC2016 nativePDF25-26 doxycycline allergy and immediate hypersensitivity limitation; current CDC RMSF care.
